textos.As opiniões se dividem sobre a construçã: Opinions are divided on the construction of the script and its dramatic structure. While nearly all of those who disapprove point to superficiality and weakness in the writing, most of those who approve focus their analysis on the dynamic developed between Porco and Fio.

textos.As reviews elogiam a beleza visual do fi: The reviews praise the film's visual beauty, especially the aerial sequences and the director's passion for aviation, as well as the Adriatic settings and the hand-drawn backgrounds.
textos.Várias reviews positivas valorizam a crí: Several positive reviews value the critique of fascism and war, seen as a political message that remains current, and cite the line in which the protagonist says he would rather be a pig than a fascist.
textos.Este grupo descreve o filme como mais ma: This group describes the film as more mature and melancholic within the studio's filmography, dealing with guilt, disillusionment and isolation in a way that is light on the surface and heavy underneath.

textos.Dirigido por Hayao Miyazaki e lançado em: Directed by Hayao Miyazaki and released in 1992, Porco Rosso is an adventure and fantasy animation set in the Adriatic Sea during the interwar period. The narrative follows a former Italian Air Force pilot who, transformed into a pig, works as a bounty hunter amid economic recession and the rise of fascism.
textos.O longa-metragem estrutura-se em sequênc: The feature is structured around aviation sequences and seaplane confrontations in maritime settings. The pacing balances an atmosphere of adventure with passages of a comic tone and moments of melancholy.
textos.Os grupos concordam sobre o que o filme: The groups agree on what the film is and disagree on whether it works. In the vast majority of ratings (~86%), a significant share praises the beauty of the animation and the flying scenes, while a considerable number value the anti-war and anti-fascist message. In this same range, a portion stresses the film's mature, melancholic tone.
textos.Para quem se posiciona numa fração mínim: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~12%), a good portion express discomfort with the relationship between the protagonist and the young mechanic, although several positively highlight the animation and the flights, and many point to problems with pacing and the script. From the perspective of those in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~2%), most criticize the dynamic between the adult and the adolescent, a considerable number point to traces of misogyny in the treatment of the female characters and some report that the slow pace makes the experience tiring.
